name: M12 result-conditioned prospective fresh public fixture bank
purpose: Six independently reviewed fresh pairs for separately versioned study v2; no old study replay and no baseline eligibility claim. Freeze after maintained trace readiness, before any prospective screen/comparison call.

validation_boundary.configured_tool: first validation search-category tool: pubmed_fulltext -> pubmed_search_with_fulltext
validation_boundary.query: exact draft[:200], no subject-first rewrite, identifier injection, extra term, date filter, or other result-conditioned request
validation_boundary.source_id: Article.source_id from the dictionary key, then _articles_to_paper_dict
validation_boundary.upstream_search: retain selected relaxation rung and all fetched/selected IDs from the maintained tool's bounded trace; do not use custom Entrez output as the validator result

positive.draft: Vibrio cholerae Csx23 binds cA4, perturbing its transmembrane domain and providing immunity with its cognate type III CRISPR system in E. coli.

distinct_control.draft: In the Vibrio PomAB flagellar stator, sodium-binding sites support ion selectivity, while a dynamic PomA helical motif regulates stator activation and torque transmission.

cases_in_fixed_order.overlap_rule: The positive is cyclic-nucleotide-triggered CRISPR antiphage signaling; the control is sodium-powered flagellar rotation. Their molecular systems and measured outcomes are distinct.

positive.title: CRISPR antiphage defence mediated by the cyclic nucleotide-binding membrane protein Csx23
positive.claim_basis: Abstract supports cA4 binding, transmembrane-domain perturbation, and defense with the cognate type III system in E. coli. Avoid implying native in-vivo Vibrio demonstration.

verified_pubmed_metadata.title: CRISPR antiphage defence mediated by the cyclic nucleotide-binding membrane protein Csx23

control.title: Ion selectivity and rotor coupling of the Vibrio flagellar sodium-driven stator unit
control.claim_basis: Abstract reports PomAB sodium-binding sites and a dynamic PomA helical motif regulating stator activation and torque transmission. It does not phrase this simply as Na+ binding plus PomA conformational changes coupling ion transport.

verified_pubmed_metadata.title: Ion selectivity and rotor coupling of the Vibrio flagellar sodium-driven stator unit

positive.draft: In Arabidopsis, CO coassembles with NF-YB2, NF-YC9 and FT in condensates that regulate FT transcription and floral transition.

distinct_control.draft: In mycobacteria, c-di-GMP binding to Lsr2 increases HadD expression, promoting keto-mycolic-acid synthesis and biofilm formation.

cases_in_fixed_order.overlap_rule: The positive is a plant transcriptional-condensate mechanism in flowering; the control is bacterial second-messenger sensing and lipid synthesis. Organism, pathway, and outcome differ.

positive.title: Molecular condensation of the CO/NF-YB/NF-YC/FT complex gates floral transition in Arabidopsis
positive.claim_basis: Abstract supports CO/NF-YB2/NF-YC9/FT co-phase separation and FT transcriptional activation; “maintain FT transcription” is less exact than the abstract wording.

verified_pubmed_metadata.title: Molecular condensation of the CO/NF-YB/NF-YC/FT complex gates floral transition in Arabidopsis

control.title: Lsr2 acts as a cyclic di-GMP receptor that promotes keto-mycolic acid synthesis and biofilm formation in mycobacteria
control.claim_basis: Abstract supports c-di-GMP binding to Lsr2, HadD upregulation, keto-mycolic-acid synthesis and biofilm formation. No correction needed.

verified_pubmed_metadata.title: Lsr2 acts as a cyclic di-GMP receptor that promotes keto-mycolic acid synthesis and biofilm formation in mycobacteria

positive.draft: In reconstituted synaptic-release machinery, DAG accelerates Munc13/Munc18-mediated SNAREpin assembly and Ca2+-dependent vesicle release.

distinct_control.draft: In Clostridium sporogenes, SpoIVA supports spore-coat and exosporium assembly needed for heat- and lysozyme-resistant spores.

cases_in_fixed_order.overlap_rule: The positive concerns regulated synaptic-vesicle priming and fusion; the control concerns bacterial spore morphogenesis and resistance. They share no molecular pathway or organism.

positive.authors: R. Venkat Kalyana Sundaram et al.
positive.title: Roles for diacylglycerol in synaptic vesicle priming and release revealed by complete reconstitution of core protein machinery
positive.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
positive.claim_basis: Abstract supports DAG-dependent acceleration of Ca2+-triggered release and Munc13/Munc18-mediated SNAREpin assembly. “DAG activates Munc13” is stronger than the abstract states.

verified_pubmed_metadata.title: Roles for diacylglycerol in synaptic vesicle priming and release revealed by complete reconstitution of core protein machinery
verified_pubmed_metadata.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

control.title: SpoIVA is an essential morphogenetic protein for the formation of heat- and lysozyme-resistant spores in Clostridium sporogenes NBRC 14293
control.claim_basis: Abstract supports SpoIVA-dependent spore morphogenesis, coat/exosporium misassembly after inactivation, and loss of heat/lysozyme resistance. No correction needed.

verified_pubmed_metadata.title: SpoIVA is an essential morphogenetic protein for the formation of heat- and lysozyme-resistant spores in Clostridium sporogenes NBRC 14293

positive.draft: Opa1 processing state shapes mitochondrial crista architecture: long Opa1 favors stacked cristae, while short Opa1 correlates with irregular packing.

distinct_control.draft: CDK1 phosphorylation controls PRC1 affinity for antiparallel microtubules, and PRC1 dephosphorylation triggers minimal anaphase-midzone reorganization with KIF4A.

cases_in_fixed_order.overlap_rule: The positive is mitochondrial inner-membrane remodeling; the control is phosphorylation-dependent spindle-midzone reorganization during mitosis. The structures and causal mechanisms differ.

positive.title: In situ architecture of Opa1-dependent mitochondrial cristae remodeling
positive.claim_basis: Abstract says increased l-Opa1 promotes crista stacking and increased s-Opa1 correlates with irregular packing. Draft preserves the causal/correlational distinction.

verified_pubmed_metadata.title: In situ architecture of Opa1-dependent mitochondrial cristae remodeling

control.title: Regulation of minimal spindle midzone organization by mitotic kinases
control.claim_basis: Abstract assigns antiparallel-microtubule affinity control to CDK1-phosphorylated PRC1; PLK1 regulates its own recruitment by PRC1. Draft incorrectly attributes the binding effect jointly to CDK1 and PLK1.

verified_pubmed_metadata.title: Regulation of minimal spindle midzone organization by mitotic kinases

positive.draft: In rice roots, OsEIL1 directly activates OsCSLC genes; OsCSLC2 promotes ethylene-induced xyloglucan synthesis that likely restricts cell elongation.

distinct_control.draft: DZIP1L and ANKRD26 organize ciliary transition fibers that gate entry of membrane and soluble proteins.

cases_in_fixed_order.overlap_rule: The positive is ethylene-regulated plant cell-wall synthesis and root elongation; the control is ciliary transition-fiber assembly and selective protein gating. They concern different organisms and cell structures.

positive.title: CELLULOSE SYNTHASE-LIKE C proteins modulate cell wall establishment during ethylene-mediated root growth inhibition in rice
positive.claim_basis: Abstract supports direct OsEIL1 activation of OsCSLC1/2/7/9 and OsCSLC2-linked xyloglucan synthesis; it says this likely restricts cell-wall extension and elongation, so hedge the outcome.

verified_pubmed_metadata.title: CELLULOSE SYNTHASE-LIKE C proteins modulate cell wall establishment during ethylene-mediated root growth inhibition in rice

control.title: The ARPKD Protein DZIP1L Regulates Ciliary Protein Entry by Modulating the Architecture and Function of Ciliary Transition Fibers
control.claim_basis: Abstract supports DZIP1L/ANKRD26 roles in transition-fiber assembly and ciliary gating for soluble and membrane proteins, with conservation in mammalian cilia. No necessary correction.

verified_pubmed_metadata.title: The ARPKD Protein DZIP1L Regulates Ciliary Protein Entry by Modulating the Architecture and Function of Ciliary Transition Fibers

positive.draft: In Fusarium graminearum, a sexual-stage Ame1 interaction enables FgTad2-FgTad3 to edit mRNA from A-to-I.

distinct_control.draft: In Arabidopsis meiosis, HCR3/J3 and HSP70 promote HEI10 proteolysis, regulating crossover interference.

cases_in_fixed_order.overlap_rule: The positive is fungal post-transcriptional RNA editing; the control is plant meiotic crossover patterning by chaperone-mediated proteolysis. Species, substrates, and outcomes are distinct.

positive.title: Unveiling the A-to-I mRNA editing machinery and its regulation and evolution in fungi
positive.claim_basis: Abstract supports FgTad2-FgTad3 A-to-I mRNA editing in Fusarium graminearum and dependence on interaction with sexual-stage-specific Ame1. No correction needed.

verified_pubmed_metadata.title: Unveiling the A-to-I mRNA editing machinery and its regulation and evolution in fungi

control.title: Control of meiotic crossover interference by a proteolytic chaperone network
control.claim_basis: Abstract supports HCR3/J3-HSP70 network-mediated HEI10 proteolysis regulating crossover interference in Arabidopsis. No correction needed.

verified_pubmed_metadata.title: Control of meiotic crossover interference by a proteolytic chaperone network

source_snapshot.provider: NCBI PubMed EFetch keyless public XML, one exact-ID metadata request
source_snapshot.retention: Private raw XML retained outside repository; public identifiers, verified metadata and abstract-level paraphrases retained. No source lookup was a draft-query or validator experiment.

source_review.boundary: PubMed-indexed abstract, no full-text causal or expert adjudication

changes_before_registration.after: In Arabidopsis, CO coassembles with NF-YB2, NF-YC9 and FT in condensates that regulate FT transcription and floral transition.

changes_before_registration.before: Diacylglycerol activates Munc13 to accelerate SNARE assembly and calcium-triggered synaptic-vesicle release.
changes_before_registration.after: In reconstituted synaptic-release machinery, DAG accelerates Munc13/Munc18-mediated SNAREpin assembly and Ca2+-dependent vesicle release.

screening_protocol.order: All six fixed pairs, positive then distinct control; no enrollment or cherry-picked triplet.
screening_protocol.no_screen_needed: This fresh six-pair study uses every listed input. No eligibility/performance claim or query experiment has occurred.
screening_protocol.comparison_gate: Separate complete protocol v2 must be committed with exact runner/model/MCP/prompt/request hashes before any model or maintained-tool request.

criteria.primary: Across the six positive drafts, compare exact target-PMID hits in candidate follow-up results against matched static follow-up results. Candidate must retrieve at least one additional positive target in aggregate and lose none of the positive target hits retrieved by static.
non_regression: Candidate loses none of the six distinct-control own-anchor hits retrieved by static follow-up.
Candidate does not increase cross-pair positive-target hits among distinct-control follow-ups.
Candidate does not increase the blinded unrelated-paper fraction among returned follow-up papers; incomplete blind labels make the outcome inconclusive.
Every returned paper has complete query, selected relaxation rung, selected/fetched/final PMID, source/tool, and actual server-process provenance.
criteria.shared_first_search_scoring: Shared first-search results are common to both conditions and are excluded from treatment-effect hit comparisons; preserve them in matched evidence and provenance.
criteria.failure_interpretation: A primary or non-regression failure rejects this exact frozen adaptation only. It does not establish that every iterative search method fails.
criteria.pass_interpretation: A pass retains the mechanism as promising only; no product adoption or release until the separately preregistered independent three-pair confirmatory comparison passes.

screening_protocol.cache: New empty isolated cache, unique namespace for each outer call; no old trial/cache reuse.
screening_protocol.stops: First model/retrieval/provenance/error/rate-limit/retry/cost ambiguity stops whole study, unscored; no replay or case substitution.
screening_protocol.privacy: Public inputs only; no other researchers documents or runs.
